name: Sabdi
title: Son of Serah from the tribe of Judah
summary: Sabdi (also known as Zimri) was the son of Serah and grandson of Judah. He is best known as the grandfather of Achan, who stole from the devoted things after the conquest of Jericho, which led to Israel's defeat at Ai and Achan's execution.

keyEvents.title: Sabdi's lineage
keyEvents.description: Sabdi is mentioned as the son of Serah and father of Karmi in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah, and thus grandfather to Achan who sinned against the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Achan's sin uncovered
keyEvents.description: When Israel suffered defeat at Ai, God revealed that Achan, Sabdi's grandson, had taken from the devoted things from Jericho. Joshua had the tribes come forward, and the tribe of Judah was selected, then the clan of Zerah, and finally the family of Zabdi.

keyEvents.title: Israel's defeat at Ai
keyEvents.description: Because of the sin in Sabdi's lineage, Israel suffered a humiliating defeat at Ai, where about 36 men fell. This showed that sin in the camp had consequences for the entire people.

keyEvents.title: God's Judgment on Achan's Family
keyEvents.description: After the sin was exposed, Achan along with his family and possessions were taken to the Valley of Achor, where they were stoned and burned as judgment for disobedience to God's command.

keyEvents.title: Zabdi in Judah's Genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Zabdi (Zimri) is also mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of Judah's lineage, where the genealogy confirms his position as a son of Zerah.
